'''Fabien Morel'''  (born 22 January 1965) is a French [[algebraic geometry|algebraic geometer]] and key developer of [[A¹ homotopy theory]] with [[Vladimir Voevodsky]].<ref>{{Citation | last1=Morel | first1=Fabien | last2=Voevodsky | first2=Vladimir | author2-link=Vladimir Voevodsky | title='''A'''<sup>1</sup>-homotopy theory of schemes | url=http://archive.numdam.org/article/PMIHES_1999__90__45_0.pdf | accessdate=9 May 2008 | mr=1813224  | year=1999 | journal=[[Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS]] | issue=90 | pages=45–143 | doi=10.1007/BF02698831 | volume=90}}</ref> Among his accomplishments is the proof of the Friedlander conjecture, and the proof of the complex case of the [[Milnor conjecture (K-theory)|Milnor conjecture]] stated in [[John Milnor|Milnor's]] 1983 paper 'On the homology of [[Lie group]]s made discrete'. This result was presented at the Second Abel Conference, held in January–February 2012.

In 2006, he was an invited speaker with a talk on ''A<sup>1</sup>-algebraic topology'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Madrid]].<ref>{{cite book|chapter=''A<sup>1</sup>-algebraic topology'' by Fabien Morel|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, Madrid, 2006|volume=II|publisher=European Math. Soc.|year=2006|pages=1035–1059|url=http://www.icm2006.org/proceedings/Vol_II/contents/ICM_Vol_2_49.pdf|access-date=17 November 2019|archive-date=24 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924032624/http://www.icm2006.org/proceedings/Vol_II/contents/ICM_Vol_2_49.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=fUa5BQAAQBAJ ''A<sup>1</sup>-algebraic topology over a field.''] (= Lecture Notes in Mathematics. 2052). Springer, 2012, {{ISBN|978-3-642-29513-3}}.
* with [[Marc Levine (mathematician)|Marc Levine]]: [https://books.google.com/books?id=obVAAAAAQBAJ ''Algebraic Cobordism.''] Springer, 2007, {{ISBN|978-3-540-36822-9}}.
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=LRlWCUfH430C ''Homotopy theory of Schemes.''] American Mathematical Society, 2006 (French original published by [[Société Mathématique de France]] 1999)
